decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the palette, visual style, brand impression, layout direction, and application to master and location pages; no additional state change or stale key is present.

The existing same-message MODIFY already requires future locations to be addable without redesign and replaces location-specific customization with wording only, consistently removing branding as a location-specific customization.
The shared visual-brand decision does not alter the hub's existing role, location routing, navigation, or booking ownership.
The branding and positioning changes do not alter the independently established SMASHROOMUSA.com master-site domain assignment.
Cross-location visual consistency does not change the Wix Bookings platform requirement for location sites.
A shared customer-facing brand does not change the requirement that bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, and management remain isolated per location.
